name: omi_incluster_guard_unsafe
description: Unsafe production guard verdicts (TRIP, BLIND or read errors), emitted even when the batch observer does not fail the Job. Alert on the counter, never scan raw logs from Grafana.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name=("guard" OR "batch-guard") AND jsonPayload.message=~"\"page_signal\": true"
